verdict.rationale: Vestd documents digital cap table management as "one source of truth, reconciled," with share classes chosen when issuing shares, share certificates, EMI, CSOP and unapproved option grants, and data rooms where cap tables can be shared with controlled access. However, nothing in the evidence covers SAFEs or convertible instruments, and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: SAFE/convertible instrument tracking, detail on certificate management beyond a page title, documented auditor-facing workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on

citations.quote:
